title: Superwhisper vs Wispr Flow in 2026: price, offline dictation and platforms compared
metaTitle: Superwhisper vs Wispr Flow: price, offline, platforms
description: Superwhisper vs Wispr Flow compared: price, offline dictation, platforms and features, with prices from each company's own site. Plus a third option for Mac.
intro: Superwhisper vs Wispr Flow comes down to offline and price versus polish. Superwhisper offers offline models and a lower price; Wispr Flow focuses on clean, edited dictation across Mac, Windows and phones.
tldr: Superwhisper Pro is $8.49/month; Wispr Flow Pro is $15/month ($12 billed annually).
Superwhisper has offline models. Wispr Flow's site does not say it runs on device.
Both run on Mac, Windows, iOS and Android.
Want screen-aware help, not only dictation? Lazur is a third option on Mac.

products.name: Superwhisper
products.summary: Dictation with local and cloud models, offline transcription, custom vocabulary and modes like Message and Email. You can bring your own API keys.
bestFor: You like tuning models and modes

products.name: Wispr Flow
products.pricing: Free plan with limited words per week; Pro $15/month or $12/month billed annually
products.summary: AI dictation that cleans up as you speak: removes filler words, adds punctuation, works in any app, 100+ languages, personal dictionary and snippets.
bestFor: You need it on Windows or your phone too

products.name: Lazur
products.pricing: 3-day free trial, then Pro $18/month or Power $120/month
products.summary: A voice assistant in the Mac notch. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and it sees your screen, answers out loud, points at buttons and walks you through apps. Hold fn to dictate in any app.
bestFor: You want help with what is on your screen, not only typing
You learn new Mac apps often
You want dictation and an assistant in one app

values: Voice assistant that sees your screen; dictation included

table.feature: Points at buttons, guides you through apps

values: No, cloud while you hold the key; nothing stored
Free plan with limited words per week; Pro $15/month or $12/month billed annually
3-day free trial, then Pro $18/month or Power $120/month

verdict: Pick Superwhisper for offline dictation and a lower price. Pick Wispr Flow for polished dictation with less setup. If you want a Mac assistant that also dictates, look at Lazur.

blocks.text: On their own pricing pages, Superwhisper Pro is $8.49/month, $84.99/year or $249.99 lifetime. Wispr Flow Pro is $15/month or $12/month billed annually. Both have free plans with limits.
Superwhisper lets you choose local or cloud models and bring your own API keys. Wispr Flow lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and HIPAA with a signed BAA, and lets you opt out of model training.

faq.question: Is Superwhisper cheaper than Wispr Flow?
faq.answer: Yes. Superwhisper Pro is $8.49/month against $15/month for Wispr Flow Pro, on each company's site.

faq.question: Which one works offline?
faq.answer: Superwhisper offers offline models. Wispr Flow's site does not say dictation runs on device.
